titel: Add ankle joints to your 3D printed figure 🔥 | Blender

eind.zin: Elbows and knees stop where your rig stops.

printzin: Measured in Blender, not print tested by us yet.

scenes.tekst: Does your figure stand on stiff feet?
scenes.label: QUICK QUESTION

scenes.tekst: Figure from rig gives shoulders, elbows, hips, knees and the neck by default.
scenes.label: DEFAULT

scenes.tekst: For the ankles too, press More bones, right under Figure from rig.
scenes.label: MORE BONES

scenes.tekst: It cuts the robot into parts, with a joint at each one.
scenes.label: PARTS

scenes.tekst: Select the rigged mesh first, then press it, and the ankles join the list.
scenes.label: ANKLES

scenes.tekst: You find it in the N panel, under Click Joints, in Figure joints.
scenes.label: WHERE

scenes.tekst: No rig? There is an Ankle preset: put the 3D cursor on the ankle.
scenes.label: NO RIG

scenes.tekst: Drag Bend on the knee, and it stops at the angle from your rig.
scenes.label: STOP

scenes.tekst: Exploded view pulls the parts apart.
scenes.label: LOOK INSIDE

scenes.tekst: Measured in Blender, not print tested by us yet. Print a test joint first.
scenes.label: HONEST

scenes.tekst: Click Joints Pro. Elbows and knees stop where your rig stops.
scenes.label: CLICK JOINTS PRO
